gaps.detail: No test checks that a bad stored priority on a done task is reported by `list --all --tag X` (AC-8: with --all the check covers done tasks, before the --tag filter). Only plain `list --all` is tested for done tasks (test_ac8_malformed_priority_on_a_done_task_is_reported_by_list_all in tests/test_priority.py). Add a case with a done task of bad priority that lacks tag X and assert exit 2 with the by-id stderr.
No test combines `add --priority high` with `--due` and `--tag` and checks that the stored task keeps all of due, tags and priority together. Add one in tests/test_priority.py.
